children: DALLAS, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust ("NXDT") (
) announced today that the Company is scheduled to host a conference call on Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET (10:00 am CT), to discuss portfolio updates and recent performance.

The conference call can be accessed live over the phone by dialing 833-461-5787 or, for international callers, +1 365-657-4084 and using passcode Conference ID: 274211798. A live audio webcast of the call will be available online at the Company's website,
(under "Resources"). An online replay will be available shortly after the call on the Company's website and continue to be available for 60 days.
About NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust

NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust is an externally advised, publicly traded, diversified real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the acquisition, development, and management of opportunistic and value-add investments throughout the United States across multiple sectors where NexPoint and its affiliates have operational expertise. NXDT is externally advised by NexPoint Real Estate Advisors X, L.P. For more information, please visit nxdt.nexpoint.com.
